nodes.title: SkyLoom story covers render at full height
nodes.description: On SkyLoom's blog index and home-page story carousel a photo cover renders at its intrinsic height (900px for a 1600x900 image), because `.journal-media` sets width but not `height: auto`, so the img height attribute wins over aspect-ratio.

nodes.title: Payload CMS
nodes.description: Adapter — Payload Local API on Supabase Postgres and Storage. Pages use the page-block composer. Payload localizes every language of the f-languages catalog; each Site record names its own languages and default language. Each Site has a fixed platform address and an optional expiry; its canonical address is derived. Access comes from Supabase: an admin sees every site; a user reads and changes only the sites listed on their Supabase account. Server code can read the signed-in account and add a site to a user's account.
